questions.question: Kubernetes arxitekturasi: control plane va worker node komponentlari?
questions.explanation: Control plane: kube-apiserver (yagona kirish nuqtasi), etcd (holat), scheduler (pod'ni node'ga joylash), controller-manager (desired state'ni ushlab turish). Node: kubelet (pod'ni ishga tushiradi), container runtime (containerd), kube-proxy (Service trafigi).

questions.question: Deployment manifestini qanday yozasiz? Asosiy maydonlar?
questions.explanation: `apiVersion: apps/v1`, `kind: Deployment`, `metadata`, `spec.replicas`, `spec.selector.matchLabels` (template label'lari bilan mos), `spec.template` (pod: container image, port, resources, probe'lar).

questions.question: `kubectl rollout` bilan deploy, status va rollback qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: `kubectl set image` yoki `apply` yangi ReplicaSet yaratadi; `rollout status` kutadi; `rollout history` revision'lar; `rollout undo` oldingi ReplicaSet'ga qaytaradi.

questions.question: Helm nima: chart, release, values?
questions.explanation: Helm — K8s paket menejeri. Chart — shablonlangan manifestlar to'plami; values — sozlanadigan qiymatlar; release — chart'ning cluster'ga o'rnatilgan nusxasi (revision'lar bilan).

questions.question: Kustomize nima va Helm'dan farqi?
questions.explanation: Kustomize — shablonsiz: base manifest + overlay patch'lar (`kubectl apply -k`). Helm — template engine + paketlash + release tarixi. Kustomize oddiy o'z ilovalari uchun, Helm uchinchi tomon paketlari va murakkab parametrlash uchun.

questions.question: Init container va sidecar container nima?
questions.explanation: Init container — asosiy container'dan oldin ketma-ket ishlaydi va tugaydi (migration, kutish, fayl tayyorlash). Sidecar — asosiy bilan birga yashaydi (log shipper, proxy). K8s 1.29+ native sidecar: `initContainers` ichida `restartPolicy: Always`.

questions.question: kubeconfig, context va namespace bilan qanday ishlaysiz?
questions.explanation: kubeconfig (`~/.kube/config`) — cluster'lar, user'lar va context'lar (cluster + user + namespace). `kubectl config use-context` cluster'ni almashtiradi; noto'g'ri context'da buyruq — prod'ni tasodifan o'zgartirishning klassik sababi.

questions.question: Imperative (`kubectl create/run`) va declarative (`kubectl apply -f`) farqi?
questions.explanation: Imperative — buyruq bilan bir martalik o'zgarish, tarix yo'q. Declarative — YAML faylda desired state, `apply` farqni qo'llaydi; Git'da saqlanadi va review qilinadi. Production'da declarative.

questions.question: Label va annotation farqi?
questions.explanation: Label — obyektni tanlash/guruhlash uchun (selector, `kubectl get -l`), qisqa qiymatlar. Annotation — tanlash uchun emas, qo'shimcha metadata (tool sozlamalari, checksum, izoh), uzun bo'lishi mumkin.

questions.question: `kubectl get` natijasini qanday kengaytirib o'qiysiz: `-o wide`, `-o yaml`, `-w`, `explain`?
questions.explanation: `-o wide` — node va IP; `-o yaml` — to'liq obyekt (spec + status); `-w` — o'zgarishlarni kuzatish; `kubectl explain` — maydon hujjatlari; jsonpath — aniq qiymat olish.

questions.question: Deployment'ni qo'lda qanday scale qilasiz va bu GitOps bilan qanday to'qnashadi?
questions.explanation: `kubectl scale deploy/api --replicas=5` darhol pod sonini o'zgartiradi. Lekin manifestda (Git'da) 3 bo'lsa, keyingi apply/sync uni 3 ga qaytaradi; HPA bo'lsa, HPA boshqaradi.

questions.question: Service DNS nomlari qanday tuziladi?
questions.explanation: Har Service DNS oladi: `<service>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local`. Bir namespace ichida faqat `<service>` yetarli, boshqa namespace'dan `<service>.<namespace>`. Headless service'da pod'lar: `<pod>.<service>.<ns>.svc.cluster.local`.

questions.question: ConfigMap'ni pod'ga env sifatida va fayl sifatida qanday berasiz?
questions.explanation: `envFrom`/`valueFrom.configMapKeyRef` — environment variable; `volumes.configMap` — fayl. Env pod start'da bir marta o'qiladi (o'zgarsa restart kerak); fayl mount avtomatik yangilanadi (subPath'siz).

questions.question: Pod hayot sikli: Pending, ContainerCreating, Running, Succeeded, Failed, Terminating?
questions.explanation: Pending — scheduler joy topmagan yoki image tortilmoqda; ContainerCreating — volume/network/image tayyorlanmoqda; Running — kamida bitta container ishlayapti; Succeeded/Failed — barcha container'lar tugagan (Job); Terminating — o'chirilmoqda (grace period).

questions.question: Lokal Kubernetes: minikube, kind, k3s farqi va qachon qaysi biri?
questions.explanation: minikube — bitta node'li lokal cluster (VM yoki Docker), add-on'lar ko'p, o'rganish uchun qulay. kind — K8s node'lari Docker container sifatida, tez, CI va multi-node test uchun. k3s — yengil, production'ga yaroqli distributiv (edge, IoT, kichik server).

questions.question: `imagePullPolicy` qanday ishlaydi va nega `latest` tag xavfli?
questions.explanation: `Always` — har pod start'da registry'dan tekshiradi; `IfNotPresent` — node'da bo'lsa olmaydi; `Never` — faqat lokal. Tag `latest` bo'lsa default `Always`, boshqa tag'da `IfNotPresent`. `latest` qaysi versiya ishlayotganini noaniq qiladi va rollback'ni buzadi.

questions.question: `kubectl cordon`, `uncordon`, `drain` nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: cordon — node'ni unschedulable qiladi (yangi pod tushmaydi, mavjudlari qoladi); drain — cordon + pod'larni PDB'ni hurmat qilib evict qiladi (maintenance oldidan); uncordon — node'ni qayta ishga qaytaradi.

questions.question: k9s, Lens, `kubectl` plugin'lari (krew) — kundalik ishni qanday tezlashtiradi?
questions.explanation: k9s — terminal UI: resurslarni ko'rish, log, exec, describe bitta tugma bilan. Lens/Headlamp — grafik IDE. krew — kubectl plugin menejeri (ctx, ns, neat, tree, stern).

questions.question: Rolling update strategiyasi: `maxSurge`, `maxUnavailable`, `minReadySeconds`?
questions.explanation: maxSurge — replicas'dan ortiq nechta yangi pod bo'lishi mumkin; maxUnavailable — nechta pod mavjud bo'lmasligi mumkin; minReadySeconds — pod ready bo'lgach shuncha vaqt barqaror tursa available hisoblanadi.

questions.question: Graceful shutdown: pod o'chirilganda nima bo'ladi va 5xx'siz qanday to'xtatiladi?
questions.explanation: Pod Terminating bo'ladi: endpoint'lardan olib tashlash va SIGTERM parallel boshlanadi. Ilova SIGTERM'da yangi ulanish qabul qilishni to'xtatib, mavjudlarini tugatishi; `preStop` sleep endpoint yangilanishiga vaqt beradi; `terminationGracePeriodSeconds`dan keyin SIGKILL.

questions.question: PodDisruptionBudget (PDB) nima va qachon kerak?
questions.explanation: PDB voluntary disruption'larda (node drain, cluster upgrade, autoscaler scale-down) bir vaqtda nechta pod o'chirilishi mumkinligini cheklaydi. Node crash'dan himoya qilmaydi.

questions.question: StatefulSet qanday kafolatlar beradi va headless Service bilan bog'liqligi?
questions.explanation: StatefulSet: barqaror nom (`db-0`, `db-1`), barqaror DNS (`db-0.db.ns.svc`), har podga alohida PVC (`volumeClaimTemplates`), tartibli start/stop. Headless Service (`clusterIP: None`) har pod uchun DNS yozuvini beradi.

questions.question: Helm chart'ni qanday yaxshi yozasiz: values, helpers, hooks, tekshiruv?
questions.explanation: Values'da faqat haqiqatan o'zgaradigan narsalar, `_helpers.tpl`da nom/label'lar, `values.schema.json` bilan validatsiya, hooks (pre-upgrade migration Job) ehtiyot bilan, CI'da `helm lint` + `helm template` + kubeconform.

questions.question: Job va CronJob'ni production'da to'g'ri sozlash: retry, parallelism, concurrencyPolicy?
questions.explanation: Job: `backoffLimit` (retry), `activeDeadlineSeconds` (umumiy timeout), `ttlSecondsAfterFinished` (tozalash), `completions`/`parallelism`. CronJob: `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid`, `startingDeadlineSeconds`, history limit'lar. Ish idempotent bo'lishi shart.

questions.question: Downward API nima va pod o'z nomi, namespace'i, resurs limitini qanday biladi?
questions.explanation: Downward API pod/container ma'lumotlarini (nom, namespace, node, IP, label, requests/limits) env yoki fayl sifatida container'ga beradi — API'ga murojaatsiz va RBAC'siz.

questions.question: Ingress `pathType`: `Exact`, `Prefix`, `ImplementationSpecific` farqi?
questions.explanation: Exact — faqat aynan shu yo'l; Prefix — `/` bilan ajratilgan segment bo'yicha prefiks (`/api` → `/api/x` ha, `/apix` yo'q); ImplementationSpecific — controller'ga bog'liq (nginx'da regex). Eng uzun mos kelgan yo'l yutadi.

questions.question: `kubectl apply` (client-side) va Server-Side Apply farqi? Field ownership nima?
questions.explanation: Client-side apply oxirgi holatni `last-applied-configuration` annotation'da saqlaydi. SSA — API server har field'ning egasini (manager) kuzatadi; ikki tool bir field'ni o'zgartirsa conflict beradi. GitOps va controller'lar birga ishlaganda drift'ni oldini oladi.

questions.question: Blue-green va canary deploy'ni Kubernetes'da qanday qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Blue-green: ikkita Deployment, Service selector'ini bir zumda almashtirish. Canary: trafikni foiz bo'yicha bo'lish — Ingress/Gateway weight, service mesh yoki Argo Rollouts/Flagger metrikaga qarab avtomatik oshiradi yoki rollback qiladi.

questions.question: Operator va CRD nima? O'zingiz operator yozishingiz kerakmi?
questions.explanation: CRD — K8s API'ga yangi resurs turi qo'shadi; Operator — shu resursni reconcile qiluvchi controller, domen bilimini (DB failover, backup) avtomatlashtiradi. Ko'pincha tayyor operator yetarli; o'zingiz yozish — murakkab, uzoq muddatli qo'llab-quvvatlash talab qiladi.

questions.question: GitOps (Argo CD/Flux) qanday ishlaydi va push-based CD'dan farqi?
questions.explanation: GitOps: Git — yagona haqiqat manbai; cluster ichidagi agent (Argo CD/Flux) Git'ni kuzatadi va cluster'ni unga moslab sync qiladi (pull). CI cluster'ga credential bilan kirmaydi; drift avtomatik tuzatiladi; rollback = git revert.

questions.question: Cluster upgrade'ni (masalan EKS 1.30 -> 1.31) qanday xavfsiz o'tkazasiz?
questions.explanation: Release notes va deprecated API'larni tekshirish (pluto/kubent), add-on'lar mosligi, avval staging, control plane bitta minor versiyaga, keyin node group'lar (surge, drain PDB bilan), monitoring va rollback rejasi.
